title: The Coal the Gull Took

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The gull takes a coal and the fire says nothing. The fold loses a crust and the house says nothing. The well writes frost where a slate should stand, and by noon calls it weather.
epigraph.attribution: A saying of Low Kiln, Sill

where: The Fishstairs and Low Kiln, Sill
pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a forty-five-to-forty-seven-day-old body carried everywhere; no present-tense Chicago break and no \memory{} tag are planned this chapter --- the old life stays offstage --- and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court or collector-interior scene

scenes.title: Below the North Bridge
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 45, Ilmen 16, Sixthday, dawn below the north bridge at the Fishstairs, the morning after the Blessing. Carried down and set in the shade with the fold at his chin, the boy watches a brine-gull go off upriver with a coal not yet cold --- warmth leaving the carried fire's account with no slate entered (T088, the bird motif). He can now read the shape of Orra's forty-first knot --- a double turn, tail tucked, tied left over right, the small extra weight of a thumb --- though not its name, and keeps the shape on its own tray while the word forty stays a saying beside it, not spoken a second time (T024, T082). Mira works the eels with slime dried on her sleeves and her head held to the right where her ear had been, flicks eel-bones while deciding whether to lie, and shifting a basket shows the grey cord with the second twisted twice beneath it; the two women's boards stay apart (T059, T025). Orra, down from the Weir with eels, watches him watching and says nothing further. The clerk set for the uncalled measure puts hand to slate before eyes to the stalls and is filed on his own tray --- not Marra, not the Court-table clerk (T090, T080). Six hearings stay six and no seventh comes. Changes: a shape he could only hold on Day 44 is now legible as a shape, and a coal has gone up with a bird unentered. Advances T024, T059, T025, T090, T080, T088, T061, T082, T071/T072, T086. Withheld: the number is not spoken again, knots uncounted, no sixth sighting of the neat hand, no explanation of knot or word.

scenes.title: The House's Number
scenes.synopsis: Day 45 continued, late afternoon and evening under the Vail roof (no new \daymark --- the day opened in scene 1, and days appear in a chapter once each). Sella carries him up the Clay Yard and gives every instruction to the fire, the pot and the wool, never the basket; says *the house*; goes around the month's days and the thinner stores with a loaf moved along a shelf and no figure spoken. Both crusts still lie in the fold, neither eaten, lifted or named, and no third (T058, T060, T086). She touches the widow's mark once before the opening and at no other hour; the carried fire under blind ash and the back of a broken pot keeps four, four and a gap, and the coal the gull took is not entered and not missed (T079, T088, T065). Tarn's knife is on its sill, six years counted and the seventh held, Ash worked into his knuckles; his broom goes over the road a man takes to fetch a collector without turning, and no collector goes down it (T036, T076, T009). Jorra's bent finger leads at the damper before Sella has finished, bone-coloured slip dried to old bone up both forearms, no slate dust, the back room unsaid and no look toward the bed (T035). Garl's salt coat, hollow seat, clean dark line and proverb said to the pot hold as they held through the seven days before (T009, T013). Changes: the household's arithmetic goes on around a boy keeping the count exactly, with one warmth less in the world than at dawn. Advances T058, T060, T086, T079, T088, T065, T036, T076, T009, T013, T035, T071/T072.

scenes.title: The Empty Place in the Fold
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 46, Ilmen 17, Seventhday, morning through dusk under the Vail roof and along the yard. The household's stores are thinner than they were and nobody says so; Sella feeds him barley gruel thinned with milk from the house's own dish, two fingers behind his ear, the spoon wiped on her sleeve and his mouth not wiped, and gives the instruction to the fire and the wool (T060, T058). Alda Reed comes short with soap-and-milk, touches the little tin once inside her bodice without opening it, lays an exact date where a wonder should stand and goes off; the lie told for mercy curdles against a woman dead six days and nobody corrects it (T089, T023, T008, T073). Tarn will not count the seventh year and announces the knife to the empty yard; the collector's road is swept without turning and no collector comes down it (T036, T009). Jorra moves the damper ahead of the instruction, tells a pot it will do, and does not mention the back room (T035). One of the two crusts is gone from the fold --- the smoky one Mira put there on Stone 28 --- eaten by nobody, given to the fire or the eels, spoken of by nobody; the spent one from Stone 15 remains stiff where it lay. Do not solve who took it; the reader must be able to suspect every woman in the yard, including the girl who once put the crust there (T086, T060). Changes: the first edge of T086 pays and an unanswerable kindness becomes an unanswerable absence. Advances T086, T060, T089, T023, T008, T073, T036, T035, T009, T058, T071/T072. Withheld: no naming of who took the crust, no third crust, no quest, no recognition of the mother.

scenes.title: Frost on the Well-Lip
scenes.synopsis: One dated entry, Day 47, Ilmen 18, Eighthday, dawn to midday at the yard well, the drying racks and the road down toward the Fishstairs. Frost-bloom stands on the stone lip where the Warm has lately left, and talk says the ice will go soft before its time; the argument ends in weather, which lets the yard go home warm without owning the day (T085, T013). A number goes around from fist to mouth to shoulder and is never given; Berr Clay, short, wipes his thumb twice, keeps a figure he will not give and takes himself out of his own sentence with a slate at the watch (T077, T041, T047). Word comes up that the clerk is still at the Fishstairs with a slate for a measure nobody called, and the boy files the order on its own tray (T090, T080). The weak board in the plank walk at the Weir is heard of but not yet trodden, set beside the missing Fishstairs step and the hairline that stops short of the edge; T083 held against a river beginning to stir (T083, T085). Sella carries him at a half-pace from every open slate and says nothing about where the number went (T058). Changes: the thaw acquires a visible signature no slate will enter, and the withheld number passes another day unspent. Advances T085, T083, T077, T041, T047, T090, T080, T058, T071/T072.

scenes.title: Four, Four and a Gap
scenes.synopsis: Day 47 continued, afternoon and dusk under the Vail roof (no new \daymark --- the day opened in scene 4). Sella sets him on his bed, not in the Debt Loft, and puts the fold right without looking at his face. The single crust lies where two had lain; the empty place beside it is the warmth he most wanted and cannot reach, and he keeps it with the missing fifth, the told bell, the absence shaped like a collection and the shape of a thumb on wicker, writing no cause (T086, T082, T071/T072). The carried fire keeps under blind ash and the back of a broken pot, warming the boards by degrees and missing one breath in every four; the coal that went up with the gull on Day 45 is entered nowhere and missed in no account (T088, T065, T083). Sella goes around the house's number badly in loaves and glances while he keeps the count exactly; no collector has been called for the woman in the brook and nobody has found a word for the omission (T009, T077). Close on four, four and a gap carried into a year the district has entered and has not entered him. Changes: nothing joined, paid or explained except a taking nobody names and a count that goes on. Advances T086, T082, T071/T072, T088, T065, T009, T077, T060. Withheld: no recognition, no name, no number from Dessa, no Marra, no one in three, no explanation of the Forty, no ending.
